herkunft.wartet-ohne: waiting for text recognition – no package installed
herkunft.fassung.titel: The converted version (PDF, PNG or JPEG) that preview and full text come from – the document stays the original
vorschau.fassung: Preview from a package’s converted version
herkunft.api: text via the interface for programs
dokument.neu.titel: Reread the text layer and run text recognition again
werkbank.paket.titel: Text recognition for scans and images
werkbank.einleitung: Full text for the search: for PDFs Ablago reads the text layer itself – immediately. Scans and photos are recognised by the Text recognition package; its settings (language, straighten pages …) are on the package. Whether a document tab creates full text you set on the folder type.
werkbank.paket.da: The package “{paket}” handles text recognition. Ablago itself only reads the text layer of PDFs and passes documents without text to the package; the settings (e.g. language) are on the package.
werkbank.paket.einstellungen: Go to the package and its settings
werkbank.paket.fehlt: Scans get no text – install the Text recognition package.
werkbank.paket.fehlt.text: Since version 0.134, text recognition is a package and no longer part of Ablago. PDFs with text remain searchable.
werkbank.paket.wartet_one: {anzahl} document is waiting for text recognition by the package.
werkbank.paket.wartet_other: {anzahl} documents are waiting for text recognition by the package.
neu.text: As with a new document: Ablago rereads the PDFs’ text layer and passes the documents to text recognition. “For all” also lets text recognition re-recognise documents that already have text – for example after a new language pack. Runs in the background; Ablago stays usable.
neu.dauer: The Text recognition package needs about 35 seconds per 10 pages (amd64, 2 cores) – so roughly an hour for 1,000 pages.
neu.rueckfrage.titel: Recreate full text for all documents?
neu.rueckfrage.text_one: {anzahl} document gets its full text anew – even if it already has text. Until text recognition is finished, the previous text stays in place for the search.
neu.rueckfrage.text_other: {anzahl} documents get their full text anew – including those that already have text. Until text recognition is finished, the previous text stays in place for the search.
neu.nichts: Nothing to do – no document matches.
neu.fertig: Finished: {erledigt} of {dokumente} documents read and passed to text recognition.
werkbank.neu: Recreate full text for documents without text or for all:
werkbank.poppler.fehlt: missing – PDFs get no full text
werkbank.sprachdaten.vorschlag_one: {anzahl} document in {sprache} – the Text recognition package reads it better with “Text recognition – additional language {sprache}” ({paket}). Then “Recreate full text”.
werkbank.sprachdaten.vorschlag_other: {anzahl} documents in {sprache} – the Text recognition package reads them better with “Text recognition – additional language {sprache}” ({paket}). Then “Recreate full text”.
uebersicht.fehlt: Text recognition is now a package.
uebersicht.fehlt.text: Scans and photos only get text again with the Text recognition package.
werkbank.umwandlung.einleitung: Ablago reads PDF, JPEG and PNG itself. For other file types (e.g. TIFF scans, WebP) a package creates a converted version; preview and full text come from it. The original stays the document.
werkbank.umwandlung.katalog: with the package “{paket}” – not installed yet
werkbank.umwandlung.keins: no package – only the file icon
werkbank.umwandlung.volltext-katalog: Full text with the package “{paket}” – not installed yet
werkbank.umwandlung.keine: There are no documents of other file types.
werkbank.umwandlung.nachholen: Existing files go to the package when it is installed; later also via “Catch up on thumbnails” in the maintenance operations.
teilen.hinweis: A separate letter probably begins on page {seite} (the language changes) – split the post?
archiv.laden.original.titel: The file as it is stored – for checking a signature or for e-invoices
archiv.laden.archiv.titel: The archive version: searchable PDF/A for long-term storage
archiv.im-original: The original is already PDF/A and counts as the archive version itself.
archiv.signiert: The original is digitally signed – open the original to check the signature.
archiv.weggelassen: Contained references to external content that weren’t taken over.
archiv.erechnung: E-invoice: downloading and passing on use the original (with the XML) first.
werkbank.archiv.einleitung: A package with the permission “Store archive version” stores a searchable PDF/A for every document with finished full text. The original stays unchanged.
werkbank.archiv.keins: No package for the archive version installed.
werkbank.archiv.vorschau: Catching up thumbnails from the archive version: {erledigt} created, {offen} still to go. This runs in the background with low priority; Ablago stays usable.
werkbank.archiv.vorschau.fertig: Thumbnails from the archive version caught up: {erledigt} created, {ohne} without an image.
werkbank.archiv.keine: No documents with errors or skipped.
archiv.wahl.teil: {zahl} of {gesamt} documents have an archive version – the rest go as the original.
archiv.wahl.alle: All documents have an archive version.
archiv.wahl.unbekannt: Documents without an archive version (and e-invoices) go as the original.
archiv.wahl.keine: None of these documents has an archive version – the original goes out.
